notes: Southern Tidings news was used to confirm a few items. Very full month-grid master calendar (PDF) for 2025 and 2026, covering conference, union, NAD and school items. The website event list (Modern Events Calendar) has only a handful of 2026 entries; the PDFs are the real calendar. Office closures, holidays, paydays, report due dates (clerk, treasurer, worker reports, Southern Tidings deadlines), observance months and routine school items (testing, report cards, breaks) were left out. Internal administrative meetings (ADCOM, ADM&MIN, ExCom, office staff) are listed once with counts. The Multicultural Ministries track (Hispanic, Haitian, African, Korean) is the most active ministry on the calendar: 40 days of prayer, lay congress, certification courses, harvest and district evangelistic campaigns, its own camp meetings and youth congress. Church Ministries & Mission Development (CMMD) runs quarterly pastors' meetings and family-life trainings; Health Evangelism Ministry weekends rotate through host churches; ACS runs a summer series of back-to-school outreaches in Mississippi, Alabama and Kentucky churches. Categories come from the calendar titles; where a title does not say what an item is, 'other' is used.
